common.server_error: The server did not respond. Try again in a moment.
common.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.

login.title: Team sign-in
login.intro: SPEED CLUB staff only. After your password we ask for the code from your authenticator app.
login.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

challenge.title: Two-factor code
challenge.intro_code: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
challenge.intro_recovery: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.
challenge.use_code: Use the code from the app

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email address of your team account. If an account exists, we will send you a link.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.intro: Choose a new password for your team account. All other sessions are ended afterwards.
reset.password_hint: At least 12 characters. A sentence only you know is safe and easy to remember.
reset.link_broken: This link is incomplete or has expired. Request a new one.

confirm.title: Confirm your password
confirm.intro: This area is protected. Please confirm your password.

setup.eyebrow: Required for everyone on the team
setup.eyebrow_optional: Recommended for everyone on the team
setup.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
setup.intro: Before you can use the admin, connect your account to an authenticator app (e.g. 1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy).
setup.intro_optional: Connect your account to an authenticator app (e.g. 1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy). You can do this later, but approvals and code steps need the app.
setup.password_hint: For your security, confirm your password first.
setup.password_expired: The confirmation has expired. Enter your password again.
setup.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app. If that does not work, enter the key by hand.
setup.qr_alt: QR code to connect the authenticator app
setup.code_failed: That code does not match. Check your phone’s clock and try the next code.
setup.recovery_intro: These are your recovery codes. They are shown only now. Keep them apart from your phone, e.g. in a password manager.
setup.saved: I have stored the codes safely.
setup.skip_failed: That didn't work. Reload the page and try again.
